one_line: Graph database for storing and querying highly connected data, available self-hosted or as managed Aura cloud.
auth_notes: Connects over the Bolt protocol (neo4j:// URI) with username/password; Aura cloud instances provide generated credentials. The HTTP API uses basic auth or bearer token. No OAuth2 — not a typical REST SaaS auth model.
self_serve_notes: Free Community Edition can be self-hosted; Aura offers a free tier. A developer can get working credentials solo without sales.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Primary interface is Bolt/Cypher (arbitrary graph queries); HTTP API has a transactional Cypher endpoint plus admin/management endpoints.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers exist (e.g. mcp-neo4j in neo4j-contrib); no official Neo4j-hosted MCP confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched text was the Neo4j Python Driver 6.2 docs page confirming bolt protocol, neo4j:// URIs and username/password auth; open-source and Aura cloud.

agent_notes: Auth is DB-native (bolt/basic), not REST OAuth. Build integration around Cypher queries via HTTP transactional endpoint or a driver.
